What documents are required for a Home L: For a Home Loan, you need: 1. KYC (PAN and Aadhaar), 2. Last 3 months salary slips, 3. Last 6 months bank statements, and 4. Property documents.
What documents are required for a Person: For a Personal Loan, you need: 1. KYC (PAN/Aadhaar), 2. Last 3 months salary slips or income proofs, and 3. Last 3 months bank statements.
What documents are required for a Vehicl: For a Vehicle Loan, you need: 1. KYC documents, 2. Income proof (salary slips or ITR), 3. Bank statement, and 4. Vehicle invoice from the dealer.
What documents are required for an Educa: For an Education Loan, you need: 1. Student's academic records, 2. Admission letter, 3. Fee structure, and 4. Co-borrower's income and KYC documents.
What documents are required for a Busine: For a Business Loan, you need: 1. KYC of promoters, 2. Business registration certificate, 3. Last 2 years ITR, 4. Audited balance sheets, and 5. Bank statements.
What property documents are needed for a: You need the Sales Deed, Parent Deed, Approved Construction Plan, Property Tax Receipts, and an Encumbrance Certificate (EC) for the last 15 years.
What income proof is needed for salaried: Salaried applicants need to submit their last 3 months' salary slips, Form 16, and bank statements showing salary credits.
What income proof is needed for self emp: Self-employed applicants need to submit last 2 to 3 years' audited balance sheets, profit & loss statements, and ITR documents.
What is Form 16?: Form 16 is a certificate issued by employers showing the salary paid and tax deducted at source (TDS) for the financial year.
Do I need ITR for a loan?: Yes, ITR is mandatory for self-employed applicants and highly recommended for salaried applicants to verify tax status and income stability.
What is an Encumbrance Certificate?: An Encumbrance Certificate (EC) proves that the property is free from any legal liabilities, claims, or active mortgages.
What is a Sales Deed?: A Sales Deed is a legal document that records the transfer of property ownership from the seller to the buyer.
What is a Title Deed?: A Title Deed is the primary document proving a person's legal ownership of a specific piece of land or property.
What documents do NRIs need to apply for: NRIs need a Passport, Visa, NRE/NRO bank statements, employment contract, salary slips, and a power of attorney (POA) in India.
What is a Power of Attorney?: A Power of Attorney (POA) is a legal document authorizing a trusted person in India to sign loan papers on behalf of an NRI applicant.
Do I need to submit original documents t: Yes, the bank will verify all original documents and keep the original property title deeds in safe custody until the loan is closed.
What is a salary slip?: A salary slip is a monthly receipt issued by an employer detailing base pay, allowances, and tax deductions.
What bank statements are required?: Lenders typically require bank statements for the last 6 months showing active savings or current account transactions.
What is a business registration proof?: Proof of business registration includes GST registration, shop establishment certificate, partnership deed, or incorporation certificate.
Can I submit an e PAN card for verificat: Yes, e-PAN cards are accepted as valid proof of identity and PAN details, subject to online verification.
What address proofs are accepted?: Accepted address proofs include an Aadhaar card, Passport, Voter ID, Utility Bills (Electricity/Water), or a registered Rent Agreement.
Do I need to submit passport size photos: Yes, two recent passport-size photographs of the applicant and all co-applicants/guarantors are required.
What is a fee structure document?: For education loans, this is an official letter from the college outlining the semester-wise tuition fees and hostel charges.
What is a proforma invoice?: A proforma invoice is a preliminary bill from the car dealer showing the model, price, taxes, and registration cost of the vehicle.
What is an approved building plan?: It is the blueprint of the house certified by the local municipal corporation, showing that the construction is legal and approved.
